mira: Thanks for the update — quick q from the product side: what's our current lead-time for getting additional A100/GPU capacity in us-west vs eu-west? Procurement sounded tight.
jamal: Short answer: right now ~6–8 weeks for A100s in us-west, ~10–14 in eu-west for standard POs. We're negotiating multi-supplier contracts to shorten that. :+1:
sophie: If us-west is saturated, are we going to auto-route to other regions (eg gcp-us-central) or just queue requests?
jamal: We'll do staged smart-routing: prefer same region, then pre-configured fallback regions. Routing policy = latency -> cost -> capacity by default. We won't cross-region route for Dedicated unless customer opts-in.
anya: For clarity, autoscaler behavior we're testing uses two pools: reserved and burst. Reserved stays steady, burst is ephemeral. Example config we're validating:
```
autoscaler_policy:
  pools:
    - name: reserved
      min: 10
      max: 100
      ttl_minutes: 30
    - name: burst
      min: 0
      max: 200
      ttl_minutes: 5
  routing_priority: [latency, cost]
  fallback_regions: [us-central, eu-west]
```
jamal: Note: TTLs are important to avoid thrash. Burst TTL=5m, reserved TTL=30m. Also the router will attempt model-variant fallback (quantized) before cross-region when possible.
mira: If we cross-region route for Hosted customers, what's the SLA delta? Need to call this out in docs.
sophie: Hosted customers keep their baseline SLOs; cross-region will have a note that latency may increase and there's no guaranteed affinity. Dedicated customers get region affinity and no automatic cross-region routing unless they enable fallback toggle in Console.
deploy-bot: schedule: smart-routing v1 -> canary rollout 10% starting 2025-10-12T16:00Z (CI:green)
jamal: Procurement update: @dave is working PO bundles to bring eu-west lead times down to ~6 weeks — trying to lock contracts this week.
dave: Confirmed. I have two suppliers in talks, expect a firm timeline update by Friday. Also negotiating staggered deliveries to support burst pools.
maya: From docs: we should add a short 'What to expect' card in the Console explaining lead times, fallback behavior, and Dedicated rules. I can draft.
sophie: Please include: expected lead-times by region, difference between Reserved vs Burst, opt-in toggle for Dedicated cross-region fallback, and contact for exceptions (enterprise-sales/support).
anya: Action item: jamal + dave -> publish procurement timeline + list of fallback regions by Friday EOD. mira -> draft console copy. maya -> add docs card and link to the Console UI mock.
mira: Ack. I'll post a draft in #docs-review and ping @sophie for sign-off. Thanks everyone.
